propositions: Agents default to grep for source-code reference enumeration despite documentation preferring Serena's symbol tools, due to zero-cost bash availability versus discovery-step friction for symbol tools.

Serena's LSP cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib), while grep finds them; grep also finds comments, while Serena does not; the guidance stating an unconditional preference is factually incorrect in these cases.
Documentation guidance loses salience over multi-turn sessions and has no moment-of-action trigger or violation detection to enforce it.
Serena's index can lag behind recent edits in the same session, causing line-number mismatches while grep reports the current tree accurately.

Three independent structural changes are required: re-surface Serena via a PreToolUse hook on grep invocations, coach agents to re-derive incomplete source references via Serena during review, and remove ToolSearch friction by pre-loading symbol tools in repo settings.
